notes: evaluateExpression: 10 word-arithmetic rows only (its cap). expectedValue, paceCalculate (half marathon, 10k…), rollDice, readingScheduleFromPages days are known misses.

skills.name: expectedValue

outcomes.label: outcomes
outcomes.prompt: What are the outcomes and their probabilities?

examples: expected value of a coin flip for 100 or minus 50
what is the expected value of this lottery
expected value across three outcomes
expected payout with percentages
expected value of a certain outcome

skills.name: whatPercent
examples: 36 out of 240 as a percentage
i got 47 out of 60, what percent is that
1 out of 3 as a percentage
250 out of 200 as a percentage
what percent of 1500 is 45
what proportion is 15 of 60, as a percentage
as a percentage, how much of 24 is 18

skills.name: percentageDistribution
skills.card:
percentageDistribution — Split a set of numbers into percentage shares of their total.
  needs: values: array
  optional: labels: array, decimals: integer
  e.g. "what percentage of the total is each of 30 50 20" → {"values":[30,50,20]}

values.label: values
values.prompt: Which values should I break down?

examples: what percentage of the total is each of 30 50 20
break down my spending 450 300 250
share of the total for 1 1 1
percentage split of 7 and 3
distribution of votes 120 80 45 15

skills.name: paceCalculate
skills.card:
paceCalculate — Convert between running pace, speed and finish time over a distance.
  needs: distanceKm: number
  optional: paceSecondsPerKm: number, timeSeconds: number
  e.g. "finish time for a 10k at 5:30 per km" → {"distanceKm":10,"paceSecondsPerKm":330}
examples: finish time for a 10k at 5:30 per km
what pace is a 3 hour marathon
pace for a 5k in 25 minutes
half marathon at 6 minutes per km
finish time for a parkrun at 4:45 per km

skills.name: splitTimes
skills.card:
splitTimes — Work out the pace and split times needed to finish a distance in a target time.
  needs: distance: number, time: string
  optional: unit: string
  e.g. "split times for a 10k in 50 minutes" → {"distance":10,"time":"50:00"}

time.label: target time
time.prompt: What is the target time? Write it as 50:00 or 1:45:00.

examples: split times for a 10k in 50 minutes
what pace do I need for a 5k in 22:30
pace for 3 miles in 24 minutes
splits for 4km in 20 minutes
pace for 2km in 9 minutes

skills.name: scaleRecipe

ingredients.label: ingredients
ingredients.prompt: Which ingredients should I scale? One per line.

factor.label: multiply by
factor.prompt: By what factor? (2 to double, 0.5 to halve)

examples: double this recipe: 2 cups flour, 1 egg, 3/4 tsp salt
halve these: 1 cup sugar, 2 tbsp butter, 4 eggs
scale by 1.5: 500 g pasta, 200 ml cream
triple 1½ cups oats and ⅓ cup honey
double a list with a line that has no amount

skills.name: convertLength
examples: how many km is 26.2 miles
convert 6 feet to cm
what is 100 metres in yards
12 inches in mm
how far is 5 km in miles

skills.name: convertTime
examples: how many hours is 5400 seconds
convert 3 days to hours
90 minutes in seconds
how many weeks is 100 days
2.5 hours in minutes
a 210 minute film is how many hours
how long is 3 hours in minutes

skills.name: evaluateExpression
skills.card:
evaluateExpression — Work out an arithmetic expression exactly. Reads % as a percentage.
  needs: expression: string
  optional: decimals: integer
  e.g. "what's (18.5 * 12) / 4" → {"expression":"(18.5 * 12) / 4"}
examples: what is 2 to the power of 10
square root of 144
a third of 100 to two decimals
what is 96 divided by 8
multiply 14 times 6 then subtract 9
divide 4000 by 10
what is 20 * 200? then divide by 10
divide 90 by 4
take 250 and divide it by 8

skills.name: rollDice

seed.label: repeatable seed
seed.prompt: Which seed should I roll from? Any whole number — the same seed always gives the same roll.

examples: roll 2d6 with seed 7
roll a d20 with seed 1
roll 3d8+2 seed 42
roll 4d4 with seed 100
roll 1d100 seed 2026

skills.name: randomNumber
skills.card:
randomNumber — Pick a random number in a range, from a seed so the same draw can be repeated.
  needs: min: number, max: number, seed: integer
  optional: count: integer, whole: boolean, unique: boolean
  e.g. "pick a number between 1 and 100 with seed 7" → {"min":1,"max":100,"seed":7}

min.label: lowest
min.prompt: What is the lowest it can be?

max.label: highest
max.prompt: What is the highest it can be?

seed.label: repeatable seed
seed.prompt: Which seed? Any whole number — the same seed always gives the same numbers.

examples: pick a number between 1 and 100 with seed 7
random number 1 to 6 seed 1
give me 5 numbers between 1 and 50, seed 42
six unique lottery numbers 1 to 49 seed 2026
a random decimal between 0 and 1, seed 3

skills.name: pickRandom
skills.card:
pickRandom — Pick one or more items at random from a list, from a seed so the pick can be repeated.
  needs: items: array, seed: integer
  optional: count: integer, allowRepeats: boolean
  e.g. "pick one of these at random with seed 7" → {"items":["tea","coffee","water"],"seed":7}

items.label: list
items.prompt: Which list should I pick from?

seed.label: repeatable seed
seed.prompt: Which seed? Any whole number — the same seed always picks the same thing.

examples: pick one of these at random with seed 7
choose a name from the list, seed 1
pick 2 winners with seed 42
pick 3 allowing repeats, seed 5
pick from a one item list

skills.name: generatePassphrase

number.label: add a number
number.description: add a two-digit number on the end

examples: generate a passphrase
make a memorable password from words
passphrase with six words separated by dots
generate a capitalised passphrase with a number
a long passphrase of eight words

skills.name: countdownTo

to.label: date
to.prompt: Which date should I count to?

examples: how many days till my sister's wedding on nov 14
days until christmas
how long until tomorrow
how long ago was 1 January 2026
days till today

skills.name: savingsGoal
skills.card:
savingsGoal — Work out how long a savings goal takes, or how much to put aside each month.
  needs: target: number, annualRate: number
  optional: monthly: number, months: integer
  e.g. "how long to save 10000 at 250 a month with no interest" → {"target":10000,"monthly":250,"annualRate":0}

target.label: savings goal
target.prompt: How much do you want to save?

annualRate.label: annual rate %
annualRate.prompt: What annual interest rate does the account pay? Use 0 if it pays none.

monthly.label: monthly deposit
monthly.description: how much goes in each month

examples: how long to save 10000 at 250 a month with no interest
how many months to save 10000 at 250 a month at 3 percent
saving 100 a month at 2 percent for a 5000 goal
how much a month to save 10000 in 24 months at 3 percent
what monthly amount saves 6000 in 3 years at 2.5 percent

skills.name: gradeNeeded

current.label: score so far %
current.prompt: What is the score so far, as a percentage?

completed.label: course done %
completed.prompt: What percentage of the course does that cover?

target.label: target grade %
target.prompt: What overall percentage are you aiming for?

examples: what do I need on the final to get 80 percent

can I still pass with 70 percent
do I still need to revise for the last test

sitting at 72 with 30% of the marks still to come, what gets me to 75

skills.name: unitPrice
skills.card:
unitPrice — Work out the price per unit — per litre, per kilo, per item — so sizes can be compared.
  needs: price: number, quantity: number
  optional: unit: string
  e.g. "what is the price per litre of 2.4 litres for 3.60" → {"price":3.6,"quantity":2.4,"unit":"litre"}

unit.label: unit
unit.description: what the quantity is measured in

examples: what is the price per litre of 2.4 litres for 3.60
price per kilo for 750g at 4.20
cost per item for a pack of 12 at 5.99
unit price of 500ml for 1.25
price per sheet for 240 sheets at 2.40
what does that work out to per litre: 3.60 for 1.5 litres

skills.name: convertCookingMeasure
skills.card:
convertCookingMeasure — Convert a cooking measure between cups, spoons, millilitres and grams, using the ingredient to get weight right.
  needs: amount: number, from: string, to: string
  optional: ingredient: string
  e.g. "how many grams is 2 cups of flour" → {"amount":2,"from":"cups","to":"g","ingredient":"flour"}

from.label: from unit
from.prompt: From which measure? (cups, tbsp, tsp, ml, g)

ingredient.label: ingredient
ingredient.description: needed to go between volume and weight

examples: how many grams is 2 cups of flour
convert 250g of sugar to cups
3 tablespoons of butter in grams
how many ml is 1 cup
convert 4 teaspoons to tablespoons

skills.name: hourlyToSalary
skills.card:
hourlyToSalary — Turn an hourly wage into the yearly salary it adds up to.
  needs: hourly: number
  optional: hoursPerWeek: number, weeksPerYear: number
  e.g. "what is 25 an hour as a salary" → {"hourly":25}
examples: what is 25 an hour as a salary
annual salary for 18.50 an hour at 40 hours
15 an hour over 48 working weeks
salary for 60 an hour at 20 hours a week
what does 12.21 an hour come to a year

skills.name: sleepCycleTimes
skills.card:
sleepCycleTimes — Work out wake or bedtimes a whole number of sleep cycles apart.
  needs: time: string
  optional: direction: string, cycleMinutes: integer, fallAsleepMinutes: integer
  e.g. "when should I go to bed to wake at 7am" → {"time":"07:00"}

direction.label: time given is
direction.description: wake = the time given is when you want to get up

examples: when should I go to bed to wake at 7am
bedtimes to wake at 06:30
if I go to sleep now at 23:00 when should I wake
wake times with a 100 minute cycle
bedtimes for a 08:00 alarm with no wind-down

skills.name: heartRateZones
skills.card:
heartRateZones — Split a maximum heart rate you supply into the standard five training zones.
  needs: maxHeartRate: integer
  optional: restingHeartRate: integer
  e.g. "heart rate zones for a max of 190" → {"maxHeartRate":190}

maxHeartRate.label: max heart rate (bpm)
maxHeartRate.prompt: What is the maximum heart rate, in beats per minute? (a measured figure — I will not estimate one from age)

restingHeartRate.label: resting heart rate (bpm)
restingHeartRate.description: if given, zones are worked out by heart rate reserve instead

examples: heart rate zones for a max of 190
training zones from a measured max of 180
zones using heart rate reserve with resting 50
zones for a max of 200
zones for a max of 165

skills.name: bmiCalculate

weightKg.label: weight (kg)
weightKg.prompt: What is the weight in kilograms?

heightCm.label: height (cm)
heightCm.prompt: What is the height in centimetres?

examples: bmi for 70kg and 175cm
work out bmi for 90kg at 180cm
bmi calculation for 55kg and 160cm
bmi for 50kg at 175cm
calculate bmi for 110kg and 170cm

skills.name: splitBill
skills.card:
splitBill — Add a tip to a bill and split it between people, to the exact penny.
  needs: bill: number
  optional: tipPercent: number, people: integer, currency: string
  e.g. "split a 84.50 bill four ways with 15% tip" → {"bill":84.5,"tipPercent":15,"people":4}
examples: split a 84.50 bill four ways with 15% tip
what is 20% tip on 60

dinner was 45.60, 12.5 percent tip, two people
